name: Milli Featherwhistle
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Milli Featherwhistle keeps Gnomeregan's mechanostriders in motion. She builds and maintains these clockwork mounts for her kin and trusted allies among the exiles.

sections.title: Master of Mechanostriders
sections.body: Outdoors in the biting chill at Steelgrill's Depot, just east of Kharanos, Milli keeps clockwork steeds ready for Gnomeregan's displaced people. Dwarves and night elves favor living mounts, but Milli builds each mechanostrider herself. She calibrates its gears, pistons, and balancing gyros so it can travel across Dun Morogh's snowy crags.

sections.title: Legacy of Mekkatorque
sections.body: Milli builds her mechanostriders from blueprints first drawn by High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque. She has improved their performance by lightening the chassis and refining the exhaust vents, while keeping to the High Tinker's original designs. Her work carries gnomish ambition forward even in exile.

faq.answer: Milli is the primary mechanostrider breeder and engineer for Gnomeregan's gnomes. At Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, she builds and sells clockwork mounts to eligible riders.

faq.q: Where can I find Milli Featherwhistle?
faq.answer: Milli works at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, a short walk east along the road from Kharanos.

faq.q: Who is allowed to purchase mounts from her?
faq.answer: Gnomish adventurers can buy Milli's creations directly. Riders of other Alliance races must earn her utmost trust and exalted standing with the Gnomeregan Exiles before she entrusts them with a mechanostrider.
Milli builds each mechanostrider herself from High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque's blueprints, with improvements to the engines and balance.

faq.q: What mount varieties does she offer?
faq.answer: Milli offers standard mechanostriders with unpainted, blue, green, and red frames, along with swift models finished in white, green, and yellow.

faq.q: Why is she working out in the snow at Steelgrill's Depot?
aliases: why is milli in dun morogh
faq.answer: After a radioactive catastrophe and a trogg invasion drove the gnomes from Gnomeregan, refugees gathered wherever they could. Steelgrill's Depot outside Kharanos became a natural staging hub for vehicle testing and mechanical maintenance alongside dwarven engineers.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Milli carrying forward High Tinker Mekkatorque's technological genius. She is your people's premier mount engineer, still at work in exile from your subterranean home.
Milli's mechanostriders are the pinnacle of gnomish locomotion, with gyroscopic balance units and high-torque mechanical limbs.
As an Alliance hero, you can seek out Milli after earning the utmost respect of the Gnomeregan Exiles, then command one of Azeroth's swiftest mechanical mounts.
